verdict.rationale: The pack documents only opt-in passthrough FDIC insurance up to $250,000 through a single Program Bank. That is an adjacent feature, not an automatic sweep of deposits across multiple partner banks to extend coverage. Nothing in the evidence describes multi-bank sweeps or coverage beyond $250,000.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can have deposits automatically swept across partner banks to maximize FDIC insurance coverage

citations.quote: Opt in and get passthrough FDIC insurance up to $250,000 through our Program Bank.
